# Johnson Village municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Village of Johnson, Trustee Board minutes, May 11, 2026, item 12: 'Appoint Ashley Isabell as Village Treasurer and Tax Collector -- Will moved to appoint Ashley Isabell as village treasurer and tax collector effective May 28, 2026, Ellis seconded and the motion was passed.' The trustees' minutes of June 17, 2026 introduce 'Ashley Isabell, the new village treasurer' in corroboration. Isabell takes the Tax Collector office under the same appointment.

Village of Johnson, Trustee Board minutes, May 11, 2026, item 12: 'Appoint Ashley Isabell as Village Treasurer and Tax Collector -- Will moved to appoint Ashley Isabell as village treasurer and tax collector effective May 28, 2026, Ellis seconded and the motion was passed.' The trustees' minutes of June 17, 2026 introduce 'Ashley Isabell, the new village treasurer' in corroboration. Isabell succeeds Rosemary Audibert as Village Treasurer; Audibert's treasurer membership is ended in the same sweep (she remains Village Clerk).
